description: Govern an AP2 (Agent Payments Protocol) payment BEFORE the agent signs the PaymentMandate. Pass the agentId + the merchant-signed AP2 mandate (a Cart/Checkout Mandate or a PaymentMandate); Countersign reads the committed amount/currency/payee, evaluates it against policy, and returns allow / deny / needs_approval. Only sign/send the mandate if it returns allow — a rogue or over-budget agent never pays.

mandate.description: the AP2 mandate object — a merchant-signed Cart/Checkout Mandate or a PaymentMandate (committed total + payee)

name: countersign_guard_ap2
